text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
With the weight of Japan's hopes on her

shoulders, she lines up at the starting
gate. Let
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
begin!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué bien! The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
is here!
I'll be sending my cheers from
Japan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She's got plenty of racing experience
and skill!
This is gonna be one heated
world-class battle!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems her burning ambition to
reach the
top is really pushing her and
her team forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Also, El... It looks like you still hold the
dream of
winning on the global stage in
your heart, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
After you had stepped away from racing
to find a
successor, it makes me happy
to know that you're
back in action.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but look at this! She's currently third
last!
That doesn't bode well at all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Grass! I'm gonna go grab a drink!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Neither today's Umamusume nor I
managed to
grasp that victory.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Japanese Umamusume weren't as
noteworthy
back when I ran the race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But now we're marked as formidable
challengers.
It makes me happy to know
our talent has been
recognized, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aww, no way... I knew it. Winning the
Arc is just
impossible for us...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...It's only made things harder.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "I knew it." "Impossible."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The clouds hang heavy above our heads.
All the
while... I...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You didn't go on your trip this year.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Sirius.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're awfully kind. Did you think I was
feeling
lonely?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Is that sarcasm I hear? Or did you
need
someone to come and cheer you
up?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm good, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What sheer strength! A new chapter of
the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe has been
carved out here
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
dominated this
evening's broadcasts
from TV to UmaTube
channels and even
Umastagram Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dooong, dooong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I'm scheduled to meet
Nakayama
Festa's mentor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we'll be headed to the racing
school
her father runs. So, now would be
a good time to
get to sleep.

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next up, we'll go live with the
Umamusume and
trainer who competed
today!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
In two hours, I'll be interviewing
someone very
close to the winner of the
Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe! As per their
request, we won't be
archiving this
stream!
choice_data_list: ……これは録画しておこうかな

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You've got giant bags under your eyes. Did you not get any sleep last night?
choice_data_list: この生放送は見ておくべきだな……
この生放送は見ておかないと……
choice_data_list_en: I should definitely check out this livestream...
I really can't miss this livestream...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, research is more important
than sleep.
choice_data_list: だ、大丈夫！心配いらないから！
choice_data_list_en: I-I'm fine! No need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether the info I find concerns the Prix
de l'Arc
de Triomphe or Nakayama Festa
herself, I'll take
whatever helps our
chances of victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Would it be okay if we made a
change
of plans?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Teach...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Heh, sorry. The truth is, I've really been
wanting
to see what Festa is like here at
Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Let's save the talk with my father for
another day.
Instead, would you mind
indulging me with a trip
down memory
lane?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so every trainer at the academy
gets a
fancy office like this!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh? This is from yesterday's Prix de l'Arc
de
Triomphe... and these old articles are
about other
overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in tidying up now.
Teach's
already seen the evidence.
choice_data_list: すみません！散らかっていて……

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Not much gets past me. I can't count the
times I
caught Festa trying to sneak out
of class, for
instance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Although, back then, you certainly were
more
withdrawn. You spent so much of
your time just
spacing out.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. What's wrong with that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just didn't have anything to interest me
back
then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I was just there, not really alive, not really dead. Just, merely existing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Everything was so mundane. There
wasn't
anything to get my pulse going.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And you ended up doing all kinds of
dangerous
stuff to alleviate your
boredom. What a time that
was...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, would you mind if I
made us
some of that tea you have over
on the shelf
there?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'd love something hot to drink to go
along with
this trip down memory lane.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
The elementary school teachers would
exchange
notes at the end of each year,
so the next
homeroom teacher could get
a handle on what
their new students
would be like.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's where I first heard about you,
Festa. I
made a point to reach out to you
as much as I
could.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If you like competing that much, why not
aim to
do it professionally?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
'Cause it looks super boring. Why would
I go out
of my way to be tied down by
rules?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? That game you
were just
playing had rules. The person
who reaches the
goal first is the winner,
right?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You'd understand me if you'd just listen.
Rules
exist to make competitions
enjoyable. Have you
really not realized
that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If it's a thrill you're after, this place isn't
where
you're going to find it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I took a gamble with my choice of
words at that
time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And so, I brought you to the racing
school my
father was running.

text_block_list.name: Racing School Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
Festa, you finished fourth! It's your
posture that's
slowing you down!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
See, completely different, right? Each
one of the
students here is running as if
their life depends on
it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: So? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: My heart's pounding...

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: I feel... alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
From then, I began meddling even more.
The very
next week, I took you to Tokyo
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Amazing. So this is the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Japan's ultimate stage for
competition—the
one everyone at the
racing school is pursuing.
What do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. With your skill, you can definitely
aim for it
too. You have a great deal of
talent for racing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
After that, the years flew by. Festa made

remarkable progress at the racing school
and
soon became the top student.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just like that, I was hooked.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're so open about it now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Please, don't start, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But... I do think that point marked the
beginning
of everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That must've been when the real
Nakayama Festa
came to light.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let me see you off, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No, this is far enough. Thank you too,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble. Make sure you rest up
now.
choice_data_list: こちらこそありがとうございました
choice_data_list_en: Thank you very much as well.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Going through all those articles and
documents
on your desk must have cut
into your sleep
schedule. Please look
after your health.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's impressive how motivated you
are,
though. Anyway, I'll be off...
choice_data_list: ……！ご心配をおかけしてすみません
choice_data_list_en: ...! I'm sorry to have worried you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it Festa?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is so intense, it feels
like I'm
on fire.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Each time I run, I feel my heartbeat, the
blood in
my veins... Every cell in my
body crying out, "I'm
alive!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well then, I hope your trainer will
manage
to help you feel even more
alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, hope is what gives us the
strength to live.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hope?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes. From my perspective, you two look
more full
of life than anyone else I know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You won't lose focus of your path
forward, no
matter the obstacles you
face. That's because you
both have hope
in your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
A lot of people might say that winning
the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe is difficult
now, but I'm
confident the two of you
will prevail in the end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Live your life to the fullest, Festa. Live it
together
with your trainer. This is your
world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I will. I'll show you where this life of ours
takes us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll show you how I conquer the world.
